title: Pure Codebreaker
summary: Codebreaker DARK Warrior Link-climbing build paired with Sublimation Knight, Fire Flint Lady, and Equip Spell extenders. Whenever Codebreaker Virus Swordsman lands in a co-linked zone, it pulls Codebreaker Zero Day from the Deck and climbs into Codebreaker Virus Berserker to revive both and generate four or more Link bodies.

summary.title: Starters
points: Sublimation Knight is a one-card Normal Summon starter that equips Squeaknight from the Deck; Squeaknight Special Summons itself to put 2 Warriors on the field immediately.
Fire Flint Lady Special Summons itself from the hand while you control a Warrior, and Reinforcement of the Army searches Sublimation Knight, Fire Flint Lady, or Codebreaker Zero Day.
Ferocious Flame Swordsman and Cross-Sheep are Link-2 monsters with two downward diagonal arrows, creating the co-linked zone Codebreaker Virus Swordsman needs to resolve.

summary.title: Opening: Sublimation Knight (Link Climb)
steps: Normal Summon Sublimation Knight, equip Squeaknight from the Deck, and Special Summon Squeaknight to Link Summon Ferocious Flame Swordsman or Cross-Sheep in the Extra Monster Zone.

Extend with a second pair of monsters (via Fire Flint Lady, Living Fossil, or World Legacy Succession) to Link Summon Codebreaker Virus Swordsman to a zone your Link-2 points to; Virus Swordsman is now co-linked and Special Summons Codebreaker Zero Day from the Deck.

Use Virus Swordsman and Zero Day to Link Summon Codebreaker Virus Berserker in the co-linked zone; Virus Berserker revives both Virus Swordsman and Zero Day from the GY, destroying up to 3 opposing Spells/Traps.
Climb the extra bodies into Firewall Dragon Darkfluid, Accesscode Talker, or Rasterliger.

summary.title: Bosses & Payoff
points: Codebreaker Virus Berserker revives up to 2 Codebreaker monsters to Link-pointed zones when co-linked, and destroys opposing Spells and Traps up to the number of linked Codebreaker monsters on the field.
Accesscode Talker and Rasterliger convert Virus Berserker and the revived Codebreakers into multi-card board wipes and lethal damage.
Firewall Dragon Darkfluid (Link-5) gains counters for different monster types in the GY and removes them as a Quick Effect to negate monster effects while gaining 2500 ATK during battle.

summary.title: Spells & Extenders
points: World Legacy Succession and Monster Reborn revive Codebreaker Virus Swordsman or Virus Berserker directly into a Link-pointed zone to re-trigger their effects.
Living Fossil revives a Level 4 or lower monster from the GY, while Cursed Bamboo Sword, Golden Bamboo Sword, and Divine Sword - Phoenix Blade supply draw power and recurring Equip fodder.

allow.Firewall Dragon Darkfluid: Link-5 Cyberse boss providing multiple monster effect negations and immense ATK gains.
